issues.title: Cambodia calls for stronger ASEAN India cooperation on food security
issues.title_en: Cambodia calls for stronger ASEAN India cooperation on food security
issues.summary: Cambodia has called for stronger regional cooperation with India to safeguard food security, strengthen agricultural supply chains and promote sustainable, climate-resilient development at the 9th ASEAN-India Agriculture and Forestry Ministers’ Meeting (9th AIMMAF) in New Delhi. The post Cambodia calls for stronger ASEAN India cooperation on food security appeared first on Khmer Times .
